title: International registry for clinical observation and evaluation of extracorporeal membrane oxygenation in critical care and emergency patients (ECMO registry)
summary: Registry studie for extracorporeal life support systems

interventions.name: This study is a non-interventional study. It is a registry study to enroll patients treated with extracorporeal circulation (see inclusion criteria). The data acquisition is performed with the help of an eCRF.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Application of an ECMO device for mechanical circulatory and/or
respiratory support.
- Implantation of an ECMO device containing at least one active blood
pump and an oxygenator.
Exclusion criteria:
- Initiation of ECMO treatment at another participating study site.
